g.text: Issue #4 — proposed persistent professor-profile edit (not implemented)
Future design after model approval and database choice.
Current branch has no professor profile UI or backend.
Photo upload and post editing are separate flows.
Trim inputs; validate required name and formats
Recheck session, role, owner; validate allowlisted fields
WHERE userId = session.userId AND version = expectedVersion
SET fields, version = version + 1, updatedAt = server time
Render confirmed values and success notice
